 The data set for this assignment includes over 19,000 participants data on the Big 5 Personality
inventory. The data are from several countries, and many different sources. Your assignment is to
determine how many personality factors are represented by this inventory and provide me with all
reasons, explanations, and data you used to determine the number of factors that underly the construct
“personality.” This should be conducted in an exploratory fashion.

```{r Libraries, include=TRUE}

library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(psych)
library(nFactors)
```

```{r Input data, include=TRUE}


Big5Data = read_sav("big5data.sav")
Big5Data  =  select(Big5Data, -c(race, age, engnat, gender, hand, source, country))

```
```{r Exploratory Factor Analysis, include=TRUE}


#Calculates Bartlett's test
CorBig5<-cor(Big5Data)
cortest.bartlett(CorBig5, n=19719)

#  parallel analysis
parallelAnalysis = fa.parallel(Big5Data, fa = "fa", plot = TRUE)
parallelAnalysis

#do the factor analysis for 10
fitBig5_tenFac<-fa(Big5Data,nfactors = 10, rotate = "oblimin", fm = 'pa')
fitBig5_tenFac
print(fitBig5_tenFac$loadings, cutoff = 0.3, sort = FALSE)
```
